note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). The total and every value are hypothetical placeholders labelled as such; segment lengths follow only the supplied values. Scene A uses the values supplied under allocation A, scene B those under allocation B; by default they differ in one boundary only. No share rule, percentage, apportionment doctrine, fault, liability, winner or outcome is stated; both stages have equal weight.
